Subject: Novaline MAP: staged cutover, audit window, and milestone owners

Hi Samir —

Following our call yesterday, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for Novaline Systems. I focused on staged feature gating so we can limit blast radius and keep a short audit window for your compliance team. Key items at a glance: 

- Pre-prod export and smoke tests: target week of 2026-10-04 (Owner: Ben)
- Staged pilot (10% traffic) + QA signoff: 2026-10-18 — 2026-10-25 (Owner: Marissa)
- Full cutover (all traffic): 2026-11-01 (Owner: Novaline ops; Redwood will coordinate fallback policy)
- Post-go audit window (logs + access review): 2026-11-01 — 2026-11-08 (Owner: Novaline / Secure Audit)

Actions I need from you to lock dates: 
1) Confirm procurement timeline (PO or SOW signature) — procurement@novaline.com on copy.
2) Confirm whether the Secure Audit team needs an extended log retention window for the pilot.

Attached: Novaline-MAP-v1.xlsx (milestones, acceptance criteria, test cases).

If those dates look reasonable, I’ll turn this into a shared Drive sheet and create the HubSpot milestones. I propose a weekly 30-min sync on Fridays at 9am PT during the sprint window — happy to adjust.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clean plan. A few quick items from procurement and security: 

- Procurement: can Redwood accept a 60-day net payment term on initial invoice? We expect PO to be issued by 2026-09-29.

> 
> Thanks for the clean plan. A few quick items from procurement and security: 
> 
> - Procurement: can Redwood accept a 60-day net payment term on initial invoice? We expect PO to be issued by 2026-09-29.
> - Security: our compliance lead (Emily Park) asks for a copy of a SOC2 report excerpt showing logging/retention controls; can you share the applicable artifact?

Hi Samir —

Quick operational notes from CS/implementation (I’m owner for the pilot and acceptance checklist):

- Acceptance criteria for pilot (10% traffic):
  * 95th percentile inference latency within 1.2x of baseline for steady-state load (validated with our load test harness)
  * No data-exfil incidents; all logs forwarded to Novaline's logging endpoint (TLS + mTLS where configured)
  * End-to-end roundtrip tests for top-10 intents pass deterministic checks in 3 consecutive runs

- Pre-prod checklist (Ben): infra provisioning (GPU pool), model variant pinning, secret rotation test (complete by 2026-09-28).
- Pilot runbook: feature-flagged release + monitoring dashboard (SLOs and error budget dashboard shared in Drive). Marissa will run the first pilot cut.

If procurement needs SOW edits, Ben and I can incorporate those changes and re-export the SOW as a redline. For SOC2 / logging piece: I have a short excerpt we can share that highlights retention and log access controls — Mina, can you attach the excerpt and the section pointer?

Suggested calendar: weekly Friday sync at 9am PT starting 2026-10-01 through the pilot end. If Novaline prefers Tuesdays, we can flip.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success Enablement
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
